summary: A fire tower at Snow Hill in Greene County appears in the state tower list, but no source read describes its build, staffing or current condition.

evidence.supports: Snow Hill is the county seat of Greene County
evidence.quote: The county seat, Snow Hill, is the largest town and major commercial center in the county.

evidence.supports: the state tower list includes a Snow Hill tower in Greene County

notes_for_editor: The story is well under the 120-word floor because the only readable sources are a county history page and a tower list. The Waymarking listing (https://www.waymarking.com/waymarks/WM195J_Snow_Hill_Fire_Tower) returns only its title to fetch_text. A WebFetch summary of it, which cannot be quoted, describes an 80-foot International Derrick fire tower at the NCFS Greene County office on Fire Tower Road north of Snow Hill, posted 2007-03-01, with no build date and no visit rules. None of that is in the story; add it only after the page can be read with fetch_text, or after a North Carolina Forest Service source is found. The record status 'unknown' is unchanged. The NC Forest Service and the Snow Hill town site were not read. Per-tower search and page-read budgets were used up.
